## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/sparkline`. Each name links to its reference page, with every input, output, property and method.

| Name | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`SparklineComponent`](/api/sparkline/SparklineComponent) | Component | A word-sized chart of a series of values, to sit on a line of text or in a table cell: a line, an area, columns or wins and losses. |

### Types

| Type | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`SPARKLINE_DEFAULT_MESSAGES`](/api/sparkline/SPARKLINE_DEFAULT_MESSAGES) | Constant |  |
| [`SparklineCurve`](/api/sparkline/SparklineCurve) | Type alias | How a line or an area sparkline joins its values, as a chart's line series does: `"linear"` with straight segments, `"monotone-x"` with a smooth curve that never swings past the values, `"natural"` with a smoother curve that can, `"step"` in steps that change halfway between values, and `"step-after"` in steps that hold each value until the next one. |
| [`SparklineMarker`](/api/sparkline/SparklineMarker) | Type alias | A value a line or area sparkline marks with a dot: its first, its last, its lowest or its highest. |
| [`SparklineType`](/api/sparkline/SparklineType) | Type alias | How a sparkline draws its values: `"line"` joins them, `"area"` fills under the line, `"column"` draws a bar for each from zero, and `"win-loss"` draws a bar up for each positive value, down for each negative one and a short tick for each zero, all of one height. |

**Related types:** [`MonaSparklineMessages`](/api/i18n/MonaSparklineMessages)
